search_text: published ZDI-18-050 ZDI-CAN-5052 Advantech WebAccess BwSyncLg Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2018-01-05 CVE-2017-16724 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2017-16724 9.3 ['Advantech'] ['WebAccess'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Advantech WebAccess. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of the command line in the BwSyncLg utility. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this functionality to execute code under the context of Administrator. Advantech has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
